verses.en: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds
Master of the Day of Judgment
Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek

verses.ar: صِرَاطَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ࣢ۙ غَيۡرِ الۡمَغۡضُوۡبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا الضَّآلِّيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray
